subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “They helped with machines, solved problems, checked age-restricted items, and guided customers.”?
options: A student visited a mountain village and saw the Milky Way for the first time.
A student working part-time there said the hardest part was not the technology.
"Now it has carried two people into a new part of life," he said.
One evening, a classmate saw her working and said, "You look so serious."
